description: This file contains helper methods for importing and exporting Generalized Linear Model (GLM) regression models in Apache Spark's MLlib, including saving/loading model metadata and data in JSON and Parquet formats.

classes.name: GLMRegressionModel
classes.description: Helper object providing methods for saving and loading GLM regression models.

classes.name: SaveLoadV1_0
classes.description: Versioned object for saving/loading model metadata and data, including methods save() and loadData().

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Case class representing model data with weights vector and intercept.

methods.name: thisFormatVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the save/load format, '1.0'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves model metadata and data to specified path, including model class, weights, and intercept.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads model data from specified path, verifying number of features and returning Data object.
